# Where the tests run

<!-- Generated by `make where` from the test code (test/where). Do not edit: test/where's test fails when this file is stale. -->

Untagged tests run wherever `go test ./...` does: every developer machine, and CI's `unit` job
(`make vet race`). Tests behind a build tag need machines. CI's `tags` job compiles every tag
for linux and darwin (`make vet-tags`), so tagged code cannot rot, but compiling is not running.

## Tagged tests

| Tag | Where it can run | Tests | Run in CI |
|---|---|---|---|
| `e2e` | Lima VMs on macOS, or a Linux machine with SSH access to its test machines | 20 | 1 |
| `metal` | bare metal (test/e2e/METAL.md) | 4 | 0 |
| `metal` | two bare-metal machines (test/e2e/METAL.md) | 46 | 0 |
| `metal` | one bare-metal machine (test/e2e/METAL.md) | 27 | 0 |

CI's `e2e` job (ubuntu-latest, KVM, no SSH to itself) runs the tests in `test/e2e/ci-expected.txt`, and
fails when any of them reports SKIP (`hack/skipbudget`). Every other tagged test below skips there.

## Fuzzers

Every push runs each fuzzer's seed corpus (plain `go test`). The nightly workflow fuzzes each one
for a minute (`make fuzz`).

- FuzzDNSQuery (internal/worker)
- FuzzDecodeStrict (api/v1)
- FuzzEndpointRequest (internal/agent)
- FuzzParseImageRef (api/v1)
- FuzzRedeem (internal/jointoken)
- FuzzRenderNoInjection (builtin/kic)
- FuzzRulesTakeAnyEntry (builtin/kni)
- FuzzUnpackTarGz (internal/kvoplugin)
- FuzzVerifyIndex (internal/kvoplugin)

## Tests that shrink under `-short`

CI does not pass `-short`, so these run in full on every push; `make test-short` is the quick local loop.

- TestJoinedNodesTakeTheClusterTheyJoin (internal/controlplane)
- TestLeaseRenewalRacesTheSweep (internal/apiserver)
- TestLightNodeIsTheThirdVoteOfTwo (internal/controlplane)
- TestPropertyAPortSpeaksOnlyAsItsSilo (builtin/kni)
- TestPropertyARuleAllowsOnlyWhatItSays (internal/rbac)
- TestPropertyHostWrites (internal/moves)
- TestPropertyNoSiloIsTakenForAnother (builtin/kni)
- TestPropertyNothingOverIPv6 (builtin/kni)
- TestPropertyOutsideReachesOnlyWhatIsOpened (builtin/kni)
- TestPropertyPlacementsNeverClash (internal/scheduler)
- TestPropertySiloToSiloOnlyByAllowFrom (builtin/kni)
- TestPropertySimulatedElectionNeverTwoActing (internal/leader)
- TestPropertyWhoAsksDecides (internal/names)
- TestRemoveASystemNodeThatIsOnlyThat (internal/controlplane)
- TestThreeControlPlanesJoinAndSurviveLosingOne (internal/controlplane)
- TestWorkerSetUpBeforeTheOtherSystemNodesSurvivesLosingTheFirst (internal/controlplane)

## Untagged tests that need something outside the Go toolchain

The variable gates the test: without it, it skips.

- KEVASO_DOCKER_TEST: TestEnvRuntimeOnRealDocker (builtin/kri/container)
- KEVASO_DOCKER_TEST: TestSecretArgsOnARealEngine (builtin/kri/container)
- KEVASO_K010: TestSubresourceWildcardsNeverReachPowerfulSubresources (internal/rbac)
- KEVASO_K045: TestOperatorInstallTakesAllowStatus (internal/cli/kvoadm)
